findings: True Diff-QP (KKT) and FD-proxy reach nearly identical offline oneshot metrics on pack16 (expected when FD matches KKT).
Relative to supervised_init: mean accepted jerk drops ~51k→19k, but main_qp_accept drops 15/16→14/16 and mean_T rises ~1.51→1.77–1.89.
lambda_T=0.1 shortens mean_T vs lambda_T=0 while keeping accept rate; larger lambdas (0.3, 1.0) raise normalized loss floor without better offline accept.
Failures retained in train denominators (typically 1–2/16 infeasible per step; no fake grads).
